matches.submitted_text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB at an angle of divergence α of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3: 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.

When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB at an angle of divergence α of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3: 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1, for a period of 500 hours in case of retro-reflective devices.

When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
